title: Reading
syllabus: Analysing definitions: types of definitions and methods for expanding definitions. Reading comprehension: drawing inferences from scientific texts.

title: Writing
syllabus: Summary (précis) writing and abstract writing: condensing a text in your own words, and summing up a study's aim, method, findings and conclusion.

title: Interpersonal Communication
syllabus: Thomas-Kilmann modes of conflict management, with case study analysis. Writing a statement of purpose.
